one_mechanism.target: y_i,t = 100*(N_i,t+5-N_i,t)/OI_i,t; initial origin OI for every resolved historical outcome. Rank these raw target units, never volatility-normalized labels.
one_mechanism.resolved_error: At origin t, reconstruct exact parent at t-5 with rows available then; e_i,t = y_i,t-5 - parent_i,t-5. The target at t must be visible by current release-aware cutoff. This is prior resolved error, not current unknown error.
one_mechanism.scale: At feature origin localindexj>=65, sample standard deviation of exactly12nonoverlapping five-week targets with initialindices j-60,j-55,...,j-5 and endpoints j-55,...,j. Everytarget usesitsowninitialOI; allreleasedbyt. Exactfinite nonpositive scale foranymarket yieldswholeparentfallback.
one_mechanism.feature: a_i,t = clip(e_i,t,-.25*sigma_i,t,+.25*sigma_i,t); z_i,t = a_i,t - mean_roster(a_t). Exactly one feature. After centering abs(z_i) <= .25*sigma_i + mean_roster(.25*sigma), not necessarily the individual precenter cap.
one_mechanism.prediction: p_i,t = exact_parent_i,t + beta*z_i,t, shared single beta in[-1,1]; preserve parent cross-section mean.
one_mechanism.objective: For every resolved training origin, pair only entities within that origin. sign(y_i-y_j) is direction; exact tied targets omitted from directional fitting. logistic loss log(1+exp(-sign*(p_i-p_j)/S_t)) with one common S_t=max(median_roster(sigma_i,t),1e-8). Average loss across nontied pairs then across whole origins, plus1*beta^2. No extra intercept or market coefficients.
one_mechanism.optimizer: Deterministic one-dimensional bounded convex optimization, fixed64 bisection iterations on derivative with endpoint optimum handling. No grid, alternate feature, penalty/weight sweep, selected historical gate or extra arm.
one_mechanism.history: At most260 supplied report rows per market, each current continuous segment strictly7day sharedTuesday. Local feature origin j needs>=61rows for12nonoverlap horizon targets and a prior parent atj-5; conservatively first feature/trainingorigin fixed j=65, leaving61rows for the prior-parent reconstruction. Training feature origins exactly65,70,75,...,j<=L-6, whose five-week targets resolve in visiblelengthL. Require at least12 such origins, so L>=126 (last first12origin120 resolves125). This threshold is pinned before dates/values; no shifted lattice to maximize sample.
one_mechanism.parent_reconstruction: At each localfeatureoriginj>=65, exactparent atj withrows0..j; resolvederrorparent atj-5 withrows0..j-5 andoldFridaycutoff. Historical parent fitting mustnot inherit outercutoff, coefficients, futurerows, officialoutcomes orHouse reasoning. Bothcalls purelocalnumericalparent; only traininglabels endingj+5<=L-1 enterbeta.
one_mechanism.fallback: Unsupported horizon, insufficient history/origins/roster, ambiguous endpoint/release assumption, stale/incomplete cross-section, invalid OI/net/date, nonfinite or nonpositive scale, no directional pairs or numerical failure preserves entire exact parent bundle.
one_mechanism.intervals: Keep parent lo/hi and expand only if final point lies outside. No new residual-width model, coverage guarantee or calibration claim.
one_mechanism.resources: Local CPU and existing Python libraries only; inference candidate stdlib only. No House calls, networking, personal remote compute, model installation or GPU.

predata_source_plan.report_type: Legacy futures-only all contract months; exact stable codes fixed from v5 metadata, no market selection by outcomes.
predata_source_plan.acquisition_scope: Only previously unacquired annual legacy futures-only archives before2012, exact links observed on official source page. Source page/meta may be read; no2012+archive acquisition or reslicing. Initial fixed annual scope1996..2011, subject only to availability/schema/date metadata.
predata_source_plan.block_rule: Use these exact contiguous five-year development and eight-year reserved blocks if every required source/market/date and sample admission check passes. No alternate block or market search after metadata failure. Missing observed URLs, schemas/codes or inadequate cases stops before forecast and records eligibility rejection.
predata_source_plan.metadata_only_stage: Archive inspection exposes only ZIP/member/schema/hash, market code/name and report date columns to metadata output. It must not print/read into analysis net positions, long/short values, open interest, outcomes or scores. A standalone metadata/date script ignores those columns. Raw archives immutable; numerical panel parsing permitted only after source/date reservation and independent review.
predata_source_plan.observation_dates: Shared Tuesday report dates; retain all raw dates/exclusions. Every history link exactly7days, target exactly35days. NonTuesday/missing/gapped rows are excluded, never imputed or bridged.
predata_source_plan.availability: Tuesday+3days Friday publication is an explicit retrospective assumption. Actual exceptional holiday/shutdown release timestamps and revised vintages may be unavailable. This prevents a full point-in-time claim even when rows precede cutoff. Preserve limitation in every artifact.
predata_source_plan.case_lattice: For each partition find the first shared Tuesday on/after Jan1 of its first year; candidates are every fifth common report starting exactly there, without filtering history before forming lattice. Targets must remain within partition. A candidate needs at least126 consecutive shared rows ending at origin (zero-based current continuous-segment index>=125), plus five consecutive future reports ending35days later. Numeric method uses atmost260visible rows; if continuous history exceeds260, window start moves and its local lattice is still fixed indices65,70,... below. Record every missing/stale/nonTuesday/cadence/history/end-boundary skip. No score-based filter.
predata_source_plan.eligibility_stop: Both development and reserved must retain at least45 whole cross-section origins across at least4years under the exact frozen date/history rules; reserved spans the entire fixed eight-year block. If either fails, stop before numeric forecasting. Invalid source values discovered after reservation also stop with failure rather than changing roster/date rules.
predata_source_plan.exposure: 2012..2023 v5 and original competition practice data fully consumed, excluded here. Public method knowledge and same market families remain exposed. Older markets/regimes, revised historical files and assumed releases cannot establish current hidden-contest distribution generalization.

freezes_and_sequence: Write this protocol and independent precode source/date plan review before new source acquisition, candidate code or controls.
Acquire exact official source links/raw archives and metadata-only date/code/schema hashes; freeze date roster/reservation or reject eligibility before net/outcomes.
Implement exactly1beta candidate and evaluator; freeze exact candidate, parent, synthetic controls and evaluator before synthetic outcomes. No historical scores.
Run frozen adversarial synthetic controls once, preserve all outcomes. Failure stops candidate, no threshold relaxation.

Only if controls pass, parse numeric panel using fixed columns and roster; bind exact raw/member/panel/source/case/evaluator/parent/candidate hashes; independent source/cutoff review before historical accuracy.
Run one finite development comparison, preserve every case. If primary/guard admission fails, stop without reserved forecasting.
If development passes, run the sole fixed reserved comparison, independently audit saved results without forecasts, reject or admit using unchanged primary gates.
No publication/submission automatically follows; root reviews evidence and any genuine production House need separately.
synthetic_controls: Exact parent/hash/panel binding and future infinite/nonnumeric poison isolation at all nested reconstruction cutoffs.
Initial-OI residual arithmetic and OI-only changes at fixed net, separate share-change proxy from target.
Exact source roster/permutation invariance, constant common shifts, scales and postcenter bounds, beta endpoints/convex derivative.
Origin-balanced pairwise objective, average tied ranks in evaluator, omitted fitting ties, no pair pseudo-replication.
Whole exact parent fallback for stale/gapped/insufficient/zero-scale/no-pair/nonfinite/unsupported cases.
Fixed independent-innovation, persistent-innovation, reversing-innovation, volatility-jump/heterogeneous-volatility and extreme-single-market stress cases; retain unfavorable results.

historical_comparison.primary: Equal-origin Spearmanrho with Kendalltau secondary; exact official naive anchored scorer only if valid organizer naive bundle exists. Do not reconstruct hidden official score.

historical_comparison.failure_policy: Failure of any primary/admission/guard rejects this arm. No new features/grids/threshold changes, extra source blocks, repeated reserve or v5reslicing. Preserve v4.
